plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Race and Ethnicity Studies Major (BA) program page (poid=932). Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan are disclosed in these notes and are not recorded as plan prerequisites. The introduction states the major requires a minimum of thirty-three semester hours: a three-course core and eight electives, taken from at least four different disciplines. The program page prints no residency note beyond the verbatim program note that no more than four courses may count toward both race and ethnicity studies and toward a second major. The Required Core Courses block lists five codes -- REST 210, HIST 215, REST 202, SOCI 202 and REST 380 -- which form two cross-listed pairs (REST 210 with HIST 215; REST 202 with SOCI 202) plus REST 380; counting each pair once gives the introduction's three-course core at 9, and the eight elective slots at the printed minimum of 3 hours each give 24, summing to exactly the printed 33 minimum. Neither cross-listed course prints a Prerequisite(s) or Corequisite(s) line, and neither does REST 380. Anomaly transcribed as printed: REST 380's title ends at 'and' ('Senior Project in Race and') on both the program page and its course detail page in this catalog edition; no fuller title is printed anywhere in the edition, and none has been supplied.

courses.title: Critical Issues/Race & Ethnicity
courses.choice_note: One course from the printed cross-listed pair REST 210 / HIST 215, counted once. Both codes are printed at 3 Hour(s) with the identical title and description; each detail page states it is cross-listed with the other. The program's introduction requires a three-course core; the five codes the Required Core Courses block lists form two such cross-listed pairs plus REST 380, i.e. three courses counted once each.

courses.title: Race and Ethnic Relations
courses.choice_note: One course from the printed cross-listed pair REST 202 / SOCI 202, counted once. Both codes are printed at 3 Hour(s) with the identical description; each detail page states it is cross-listed with the other. The titles differ as printed: REST 202 uses 'Race and Ethnic Relations' and SOCI 202 uses 'Race & Ethnic Relations'.

courses.title: Race and Ethnicity Studies Elective
courses.choice_note: One of the eight major electives (24 hrs min. in total), taken from at least four different disciplines, as printed. Recorded at the printed minimum of 3 Hour(s). The major page names no individual elective course; for the elective list it refers the reader to a list following the minor, which is not printed on the major page, so no options are listed here. A completion using an elective printed above 3 hours totals more than the recorded total, as printed.
